description: Calculates the Form 2553 deadline for an S corp election to take effect on a given date (the first day of the tax year, or the day a new business began), including the weekend and holiday rule, and whether a filing today is on time, late but within Rev. Proc. 2013-30 relief, or past it.

effective_date.description: The date the S election should take effect, YYYY-MM-DD: the first day of the tax year, or for a new business the date it began (usually its formation date).

name: calculate_election_deadline
title: Form 2553 deadline calculator
